SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.2, Special Branch.
REPORT
Date May 8, 1934.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY. File No. D. xxx. Date 8 / 1934.）

Subject (in full) Communist propaganda addressed to Public Ricsha Coolies.

Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by [签名] S.I.

I forward herewith, together with summarized
translation, copy of a communist handbill entitled "Manifesto
of Chapei Public Ricsha Coolies," purporting to have emanated
from the Propaganda Sections of the Shanghai Western District
and Chapei District Committees of the Chinese Communist Party,
which was obtained by Agent A-3524 in Western Chapei on
May 7, 1934.

Kuh Pao hwa
D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

（批：file 拟）

Summarized translation of a communist handbill, dated
May 4, 1934, entitled "Manifesto of Chapei Public Ricsha
Coolies," purporting to have emanated from the
Propaganda Sections of the Shanghai Western District
and Chapei District Committees of the Chinese
Communist Party.

--------

The ricsha coolies are the most miserable of all
workers. They labour like oxes and horses but are unable
to make any money. Nevertheless they are frequently
subjected to abuses and extortions at the hands of the
capitalistic ricsha owners and also the Kuomintang,
the Public Safety Bureau and policemen of the imperialistic
Police who treat them cruelly. They pull their ricshas
from morning till night in all kinds of weather. Their
daily earnings are sometimes barely sufficient to defray
the cost of ricsha hire; how can they support their
families? In spite of all these hardships, the ricsha
owners and foremen persistently increase the rate of
the ricsha hire and compel the coolies to pay for
damage done to ricshas.

Ricsha coolies! Let us unite and observe the
following slogans :-
(1) Oppose the action of the ricsha owners in compelling
coolies to pay for damage done to ricshas!
(2) Oppose any increase in the rate of ricsha hire!
(3) Support the victories of the Red Army!

Propaganda Sections of the Shanghai
Western District and Chapei District
Committees of the Chinese Communist
Party. Dated May 4, 1934.
